This will download a lot of dependencies. Let me first try to resolve dependencies / do a quick build.

Let me run `mvn -q clean install -DskipTests` with a long timeout. But given 600s timeout per command, this may not finish. Let me start and see.

Actually, let me first try `mvn validate` or dependency resolution to see if repos are reachable. Let me just run the build. Use `-DskipTests` to speed up, but the task is to install the software which per README is `mvn clean install`. Tests may be heavy. Let me start with a build in background and monitor.

Actually commands have a fixed 600s timeout. A full build may take longer. I can run it with nohup in background, then poll.

Let me start.

action.command:
cd /workspace && nohup mvn -B clean install -DskipTests > /tmp/build.log 2>&1 &
echo "started PID $!"; sleep 60; echo "=== tail ==="; tail -25 /tmp/build.log
